title: UAE data protection laws
summary: Personal data protection includes consent subject to exceptions, correction rights and controls on cross-border processing. Scope and exemptions need expert review; this summary cannot authorize a disclosure.

title: FERPA and online educational tools
summary: Teachers should consult school administrators about approved online education tools. The school official exception has conditions including institutional function, school control, authorized use and restrictions on redisclosure of student records.

title: UNESCO generative AI in education and research
summary: Educational AI needs human agency, learner privacy, inclusion and pedagogical validation. Teachers and institutions should evaluate suitability rather than delegate educational judgment without oversight.
